informal_statement: Canonical weighted complete-frontier perimeter of the competitor's carrier.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At CMVGeometry.lean:3976-3980, the source contract is `def WeightedPerimeter {lam : ℝ} (r : AdmissibleCompetitor lam) : ℝ := _root_.WeightedPerimeter lam (FrontierMeasure r.carrier)`. Although area is dispatched by competitor constructor, perimeter is canonically evaluated on the complete frontier of that constructor's carrier. A type-(iii) competitor enters through the general constructor; the quantification is not restricted to four-arc competitors.
